title: Coding Quality Coach - Home Health
description:
The Coding Quality Coach is responsible for performing medical coding quality audit assignments and addressing agency-specific quality concerns. The scope of this job involves providing service to clients and the international and US-based coding and audit teams by providing appropriate feedback and guidance on audited records and agency requested revisions.
We invite you to apply today and join us in shaping the future of healthcare!
Key Responsibilities
Perform coding quality audits following coding quality policies and procedures, including Medicare, CMS or pay program guidelines, and ensure compliance with appropriate coding practices, regulatory standards, and contractual requirements.
Complete audits as determined by quality team's daily prioritization and support improved performance of coders in all service lines.
Analyze quality of coder reviews and provide feedback to quality management team regarding concerns.
Collaborate with operations team to ensure awareness of coding team performance against key metrics compared to internal coding quality standards.
Perform other job duties as assigned.
Required qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
At least 0-2 years of relevant work experience
Coding Certified (HCS-D or BCHH-C)
OASIS Certified (HCS-O)
Job Expectations
Willing to work additional or irregular hours as needed
Must work in accordance with applicable security policies and procedures to safeguard company and client information
Must be able to sit and view a computer screen for extended periods of time

score.why: Medical coding quality audit for home health, not software testing; requires HCS-D/BCHH-C/OASIS coding certifications the candidate lacks. Healthcare-regulatory overlap only.
